svg.text: Merchant back-end that calls the API and
Pays for orders at merchant checkouts
Scores each payment for fraud risk before
Double-entry ledger of balances, fees and
Public REST API for payment intents,
Payment intents, merchants and API keys
Key-encryption keys for the card vault
Signs and delivers payment events to
Reviews flagged payments and tunes rules [HTTPS]
Detokenizes the card for the network request [mTLS]
Authorizes, captures and refunds [ISO 8583 over TLS]
Wraps and unwraps data keys [KMS API]
Delivers captured, refunded and fee events [events]
Submits card data for a token [HTTPS]
Confirms the payment with the card token [HTTPS]
Calls the API server-side with a secret key [HTTPS]
Looks up API keys; Persists payment intents [SQL]
Enclosing frame = named scope or deployment boundary
Arrow = directed dependency; label states its purpose
